events.title: Elena Cornaro Piscopia becomes the first woman to earn a doctorate
events.description: The Venetian scholar was awarded a doctorate in philosophy by the University of Padua. She is the first woman known to have received a university doctoral degree.
events.html: The Venetian scholar was awarded a doctorate in philosophy by the University of Padua. She is the first woman known to have received a university doctoral degree.

events.title: Virginia ratifies the US Constitution
events.description: Despite Patrick Henry's opposition, Virginia narrowly ratified, the tenth state to do so. Without the largest state, the new union could hardly have worked.
events.html: Despite Patrick Henry's opposition, Virginia narrowly ratified, the tenth state to do so. Without the largest state, the new union could hardly have worked.

events.title: Lakota and Cheyenne defeat Custer at the Little Bighorn
events.description: Lakota, Northern Cheyenne and Arapaho warriors killed Lieutenant Colonel George Custer and some 268 soldiers in Montana Territory. The US Army responded with campaigns that ended Plains resistance.
events.html: Lakota, Northern Cheyenne and Arapaho warriors killed Lieutenant Colonel George Custer and some 268 soldiers in Montana Territory. The US Army responded with campaigns that ended Plains resistance.

events.title: North Korea invades South Korea
events.description: North Korean troops crossed the 38th parallel in force. The Korean War drew in UN forces and China and ended in a 1953 armistice near the original line.
events.html: North Korean troops crossed the 38th parallel in force. The Korean War drew in UN forces and China and ended in a 1953 armistice near the original line.

events.title: Croatia and Slovenia declare independence
events.description: The two republics broke away from Yugoslavia on the same day. A brief war in Slovenia was followed by much longer conflicts in Croatia and Bosnia.
events.html: The two republics broke away from Yugoslavia on the same day. A brief war in Slovenia was followed by much longer conflicts in Croatia and Bosnia.
